strings.SCHD（Schwab U.S. Dividend Equity ETF）追蹤道: SCHD (Schwab U.S. Dividend Equity ETF) tracks the Dow Jones U.S. Dividend 100 Index. Its stock-picking criteria are extremely stringent: dividends must have been paid for at least 10 consecutive years, and it uses a composite score based on free cash flow, ROE, dividend yield, and five-year dividend growth. By contrast, Taiwan's high-yield ETFs tend to emphasize forecasts or recent momentum. SCHD places greater emphasis on a company's long-term dividend growth and financial health rather than merely competing for the current highest yield.
